about: Trigger eval queries for this skill's description. A query is labelled with whether the skill should activate for it; the negatives are near-misses that share vocabulary with the skill but need something else. Split fixed so successive description edits are compared on the same ground: tune against train, judge against validation.
how_to_run: No runner is committed. `claude plugin eval` is the intended one and is in early access; until it is available, run each query with `claude -p --output-format json` and count the runs whose transcript contains a Skill tool_use naming this skill.

queries.query: that was too long, give me the short version
can you put what you just said in a table
condense the previous answer
trim that down, just the data
reformat that so it fits on one screen
same information, fewer words
too much prose in that answer, tabulate it
shorten your last response
just the numbers from that, nothing else
make that last bit scannable
summarise this document for me
compress these log files
minify this javascript bundle
shorten this variable name
explain that again but simpler
translate what you said into Chinese
what did you just say, i missed it
compact this git repo, the .git dir is huge
reduce the size of these images
strip whitespace from this string
